title: CI: add KASAN build target
description: KASAN_BUILD=1 is already implemented in test-on-aws.sh but not run routinely. Add it as a scheduled CI target to catch use-after-free, out-of-bounds, and other memory bugs that only surface under real workloads.
close_reason: 23/23 PASS on 5.15.199-kasan (x86_64). Zero KASAN/lockdep splats. Root issues fixed: CONFIG_BLK_DEV_NVME=y + CONFIG_NVME_CORE=y for EC2 initrdless boot; GRUB entry ID matching; CONFIG_PANIC_TIMEOUT=30. CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_NONE added for future runs (saves ~45 min).
